paper.title: A Physics-Informed World Model of Coupled Immune-Stromal Oscillators Reveals Synchronization-Gated Thresholds for Inflammation-to-Malignancy Phase Transitions

engineering_prototype.description: The current trainable model is an oscillator prototype, not the six-module BEPSY model. Encoder and decoder width, fixed-step RK4, positive Lyapunov constraint, MSE loss and two-visit sampling are engineering choices. The prototype does not use the paper training schedule or report paper results.
missing: integration of the pseudo-Hamiltonian generator into the trainable model
engineering_prototype.data_scope: HMP2 metagenomics is connected to the prototype. Two TCGA and three GEO series have metadata readers; TCGA STAR counts and selected GSE150115 processed genes can be read, but are not integrated into paper training.
